title: Support-ticket triage classifier
problem: a support team drowning in 2,000 untagged tickets a week
approach: TF-IDF features with a calibrated linear model, served behind a small HTTP service
result: cut manual tagging time by 70% and reached 0.91 macro-F1 on a hold-out month

title: Customer churn early-warning model
problem: a regional telecom losing subscribers without warning
approach: gradient-boosted trees on usage and billing history, with SHAP explanations for account managers
result: flagged 64% of churners in the top decile, retention campaign saved an estimated 1,100 accounts

title: Internal policy assistant with citations
problem: claims staff searching 900 pages of policy PDFs by hand
approach: hybrid retrieval over chunked policies with page-level citations and a refusal when nothing matched
result: answered 82% of a 120-question test set correctly with citations, average answer time 4 seconds

title: Retail demand forecasting for 300 SKUs
problem: a grocery chain over-ordering perishables every holiday
approach: per-SKU forecasters with holiday regressors, retrained weekly
result: reduced MAPE from 31% to 18% and cut waste on perishables by 12%

title: Defect detection on a bottling line
problem: a bottling plant catching cracked caps only in manual spot checks
approach: a fine-tuned object detector exported for CPU inference on the line PC
result: 98.2% recall on cracked caps at 25 frames per second on a CPU

title: Multi-agent research assistant
problem: analysts spending a day per market brief
approach: a planner, researcher and writer agent with a human review step before export
result: first drafts in 15 minutes, analysts kept 70% of generated text after review

title: Product recommendation engine
problem: an online fashion store with a generic 'popular items' carousel
approach: implicit-feedback matrix factorisation blended with recent-view similarity
result: click-through on recommendations rose 23% in a two-week A/B test

title: Fine-tuned tone model for customer emails
problem: a SaaS company whose AI replies sounded nothing like their brand
approach: LoRA adapters on a 7B open model trained on 4,000 approved replies
result: brand-voice rating from reviewers rose from 2.9 to 4.3 out of 5

title: Invoice field extraction
problem: an accounting firm keying invoice totals by hand
approach: OCR plus entity extraction with validation rules for totals and dates
result: 94% field accuracy, saving roughly 30 staff hours a week

title: Semantic product search
problem: shoppers getting zero results for 'shoes for a beach wedding'
approach: embedding search over product text with a keyword fallback

title: Model training on Amazon with a hosted endpoint
problem: a clinic network needing no-show predictions inside their existing cloud
approach: managed training jobs and a real-time endpoint behind their API gateway
result: no-show prediction AUC 0.84; reminder calls targeted to the riskiest 20% of bookings

title: Sentiment dashboard for app reviews
problem: a mobile studio unable to read 40,000 app-store reviews
approach: a pretrained sentiment model plus topic clustering, refreshed nightly
result: surfaced 3 crash-related themes that drove the next two releases

title: Lead scoring for a B2B sales team
problem: sales reps calling leads in random order
approach: boosted trees on CRM activity with monotonic constraints the sales lead could reason about
result: top-scored 20% of leads converted at 3.1x the base rate

title: Async document-processing pipeline
problem: a law firm whose upload page timed out on 300-page bundles
approach: moved OCR and classification into background workers with retries and progress polling
result: uploads of any size returned in under a second; 0 lost documents in 3 months

title: Experiment tracking rollout
problem: a fintech data team that could not reproduce last quarter's credit model
approach: central experiment tracking, a model registry and promotion gates in the pipeline
result: every production model traceable to code, data and metrics; audit passed first time

title: Image tagging for a stock-photo library
approach: a multi-label classifier fine-tuned from a pretrained backbone
result: tag precision 0.88 at 5 tags per image; search usage doubled

title: Kaggle-style tabular competition (personal)
approach: stacked boosted models with careful validation
result: finished in the top 6% of 2,400 teams
